title: Lemma 2.1 (new proof): structural facts behind eq:qrange / eq:rank-one-inX (central support of boundary piece) are asserted, not derived

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** §2, equations `eq:qrange` and `eq:rank-one-inX`, underlying the NEW vacuum-factorization proof of Lemma `lem:range`.

**Context.** The current `solution.tex` has replaced the old (false) four-term/`eq:orth` proof of `lem:range` (see prob-10-2/prob-10-3) by a vacuum-factorization argument. The *core* algebraic identity of that new proof,
$$|\xi^{(1)}_k\rangle\langle\xi^{(1)}_k|\;Y\;|\xi^{(2)}_\ell\rangle\langle\xi^{(2)}_\ell|=c_{k\ell}\,b^{(1)}_k\,P_\Omega\,(b^{(2)}_\ell)^*,\qquad c_{k\ell}=\langle\Omega,(b^{(1)}_k)^*Yb^{(2)}_\ell\Omega\rangle,$$
and the $\sigma$-weak passage to the limit $\iota^\sharp(e_1Ye_2)=\sigma\text{-w}\lim \iota^\sharp(S_{F_1,F_2})$ are **correct** (verified numerically; WOT = ultraweak on bounded sets is standard). However the proof rests on two *structural* facts that are asserted without derivation:

**(i) `eq:qrange`:** $q\mathcal K=\overline{\iota^\sharp(MJMJe)\mathcal K}$, together with the assertion that
$$q=\bigvee_{u,w\in\mathcal U(M)}\iota^\sharp(uJwJ\,e\,Jw^*Ju^*)$$
is the *central support* (identity) of $(\mathbb X_N)^{\sharp*}_J$ and that $(\mathbb X_N)^{\sharp*}_J=q\,\mathbb B(L^2M)^{\sharp*}_J\,q$. The equality of the join over **unitaries** $u,w$ (rather than over all of $M$, $JMJ$) with the central support of the $M$-$M$, $JMJ$-$JMJ$ boundary piece is exactly the [DKEP23, §8] structural fact and must be quoted/derived; the displayed range identity `eq:qrange` then follows.

**(ii) `eq:rank-one-inX`:** the notation $\iota^\sharp(b\,P_\Omega\,c^*)\le q$ for $b,c\in M$ is abusive — $b P_\Omega c^*$ is **not** a projection, so "$\le q$" is not literally defined. The intended (and needed) statement is
$$\iota^\sharp(bP_\Omega c^*)\in q\,\mathbb B(L^2M)^{\sharp*}_J\,q,\quad\text{i.e.}\quad q\,\iota^\sharp(bP_\Omega c^*)=\iota^\sharp(bP_\Omega c^*),$$
which follows from $bP_\Omega c^*\in\mathbb X_N$ and $(\mathbb X_N)^{\sharp*}_J=q\mathbb B q$ — but this needs (i). The membership $bP_\Omega c^*\in\mathbb X_N$ itself is fine ($P_\Omega\in e\mathbb B e$, $b\in MJMJ$, $c^*\in JMJM$ via $J1J=1$).

**Required:** (a) quote the [DKEP23 §8] description of the central support $q_{\mathbb X}$ of a $JMJ$-boundary piece and that $(\mathbb X)^{\sharp*}_J=q_{\mathbb X}\mathbb B^{\sharp*}_J q_{\mathbb X}$; (b) derive `eq:qrange` from it; (c) replace every "$\le q$" applied to non-projections by the membership/left-support statement $q\,\iota^\sharp(\cdot)=\iota^\sharp(\cdot)$.

This is a *justification* gap (not an error): the core computation is sound, but the supporting boundary-piece bookkeeping must be made airtight, since the entire commutation $q_1q_2=q$ (hence `cor:intersection`, the De Morgan identity, and `lem:intersect-pp`) depends on it.
